decisions.reason: The source changes the filler assets for the current issue; it does not change the existing word-count guidance for future issues.
Adding subject-related images to fill article-page whitespace does not change two-page spread compatibility or the total-page-count rule.
The source selects images as the whitespace remedy but does not change the approved Inter typeface, weight, or readability constraint.

The general layout requirement already includes client-supplied images as inputs; the source adds a whitespace-specific rule owned by the source Requirement without changing the layout structure state.
The requested filler images do not alter the polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The source specifies the subject relevance and quantity of filler images but establishes no new image-quality or remediation rule.
The source does not discuss color usage or change the policy reserving red for the cover.
The source replaces the prior Fun Fact filler concept with article-related images and does not change advertisement sharpness requirements.
Adding images within affected article pages does not change which cover-listed articles must be included or who determines their placement.
The source concerns filler images, not the required source of article text.
Although adding images may affect pagination during layout work, the existing requirement already mandates finalized page-number accuracy and remains valid unchanged.
The source changes whitespace-filling assets and does not alter article categories, label placement, or label presentation.
